description:
Migrate the NoteApp project from KAPT to KSP for Room database annotation processing. The project is currently configured to use KAPT ('kotlin-kapt') which slows down the build. Your goal is to:

1. Add the KSP plugin to the project (com.google.devtools.ksp version 1.9.22-1.0.17).
2. Replace the KAPT plugin with KSP in the app module.
3. Update the Room compiler dependency to use 'ksp' instead of 'kapt'.
4. Remove any residual KAPT configurations (like the kapt block).
5. Verify the project builds successfully after migration.

The project is located at ~/AndroidStudioProjects/NoteApp.
